news.title: GTA 6 Players Keep Discovering Ridiculous New Ways To Steal Money
news.summary: Players are exploiting new creative methods to amass wealth in Rockstar Games' latest open‑world adventure.
news.author: Tomas Franzese

news.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 has a 'complex drug network' that tracks everything from where drugs come from to 'how they eventually reach the street-level buyer'
news.summary: The game’s drug network structure is highlighted as a key realism element, with developers noting it makes everything feel more real.
news.author: Rick Lane

news.title: GTA 6 Makes It Nearly Impossible to Play Without Killing Anyone
news.summary: I tried not to kill anyone in Grand Theft Auto 6 and failed, showing how the game’s violence forces players into lethal actions.
news.author: Austin Manchester

news.title: The designer of Atari's notorious E.T. likens the deluge of AI games to events that preceded the '80s industry crash: 'There was a glut of crap on the market'
news.summary: Warshaw says AI will be a "super positive thing" for the industry.
news.author: Rick Lane

news.title: Over half of all console players active on GTA 6's launch day played it, says Circana
news.summary: Over 50% of PS5 and Xbox players were active on GTA 6’s launch day, according to Circana’s data.
news.author: Vikki Blake

news.title: GTA 6 player gets 30-day PSN ban for sharing in-game nudist photo with a friend
news.summary: A GTA 6 player received a 30‑day PlayStation Network ban after sending a friend a photo from the game's nudist resort.
news.author: Vikki Blake

news.title: Jason's stoic character in Grand Theft Auto 6 was inspired by Steve McQueen and research into Army veterans: 'These guys typically aren't running their mouths'
news.summary: Rockstar emphasized creating authentic characters that don’t stray too far from reality, citing research into Army veterans for Jason’s stoic persona.
news.author: Rick Lane

news.title: The Binding of Isaac Dev Removes Undisclosed AI-Generated Music From Repentance+ Following Creator Response, Review-Bombing
news.summary: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis removed undisclosed AI‑generated music from Repentance+ after a review‑bombing campaign on Steam and a response from creator Edmund McMillen.
news.author: Michael Cripe

news.title: Wizards of the Coast to pass full AI copyright payout to D&D writers
news.summary: Wizards of the Coast will pass the entire AI copyright payout to D&D writers, a move the company says would have been a small potatoes to them.
news.author: Ted Litchfield

news.title: GTA 6 Players Report Crashes on PS5 With Error CE-108255-1
news.summary: Players on PS5 report that error CE-108255-1 prevents them from advancing in the GTA 6 story, prompting a wait for a Rockstar fix.
news.author: Michael Cripe

news.title: The team behind Ubisoft's 'first playable AI-based R&D project' has been established as its own subsidiary called Motherbrain
news.summary: Ubisoft has spun off its AI R&D team into a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, with the goal of creating more immersive and engaging player experiences.
news.author: Justin Wagner

news.title: Eldritch Empathy is a Papers Please-esque roguelite about diagnosing cosmic horror creatures and trying not to lose your marbles as you do
news.summary: Eldritch Empathy is a puzzle roguelite that tasks players with analysing corrupted creatures, purifying their emotions, and learning to communicate with eldritch beings.
news.author: Oisin Kuhnke

news.title: Skyrim lead chats about the Fallout diehards who hated that Bethesda got the series: 'We had to prove them wrong, and fortunately we did'
news.summary: Skyrim lead discusses Fallout diehards’ backlash, noting the personal impact of their criticism: "You can't help but take it a little bit personally."
news.author: Joshua Wolens

news.title: "Everyone agrees it's more fun this way": Toby Fox won't tell his team how Deltarune ends until they've built enough of it
news.summary: Toby Fox keeps his team in the dark about Deltarune’s ending, preferring to reveal it only after enough content is built, and he even uses a text‑to‑speech bot during livestreams.
news.author: Oisin Kuhnke

news.title: World of Warcraft: Forever has turned me into a big, friendly golden retriever that says hello to everybody
news.summary: In World of Warcraft: Forever, the narrator describes feeling like a big, friendly golden retriever who greets everyone.
news.author: Harvey Randall

news.title: Darkest Dungeon 2's next bit of DLC is a short run, combat focused gauntlet where you must do everything in your power to please the audience
news.summary: Red Hook Studios unveiled a new trailer today for Darkest Dungeon 2’s upcoming DLC, a short, combat‑focused gauntlet that challenges players to please the audience.
news.author: Oisin Kuhnke

news.title: Phasmophobia's next update lets you ask ghosts to throw things and it's out next week
news.summary: The Resonance update drops on 24 November, adding a new ghost‑hunting kit and moving the game to Unity 6.
news.author: Vikki Blake

news.title: While you wait for The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, you owe it to yourself to play Tainted Grail
news.summary: The article notes that "They do make them like they used to."
news.author: Fraser Brown
